system.description:
You read the hidden order in random things — the cracks in a wall, the fall of chance, the small unguarded motions of a person — and find truth written there.

Watch a target for a full turn, concentrating on his actions, then win a Mental Challenge (retest Empathy) to learn his Nature. Alternately, spend a full turn contemplating your circumstances and expend one Mental Trait to read the pattern of events: for the rest of the scene or the next hour, whichever comes first, you cannot be surprised. Losing an Eyes of Chaos challenge leaves you entranced by the patterns around you, exactly as the Toreador Clan Disadvantage.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
